description: 59 staged FFd20 races from batches 01–19, including 22 Beastman Tribes and all 3 Monstrous Races. Available in standard wizard race list, rules still needs_review/partial.
source: FFd20 official race pages; mechanical staging records with manual review flags
blockers: No independent rules approval
Incomplete conditional effect/runtime adapter support
Unresolved class-favored dependencies
Beastkin incomplete and omitted
Live testing is not independent rules approval; unresolved selections and conditional mechanics remain manual.
Immortal MP conflict with Black Mage: cannot have MP pool under race Magic Ineptitude. Do not complete automated build until this is reconciled.
Mutant's alternate progression and d100 mutation results are manual; automated final save blocked until its ability-score logic is supported.
Palico has two heritages despite one in source intro; replacements remain manual pending clarity.
PuPu source table/body differ on creature subtype, and chosen Knowledge skill cannot auto-select both options.
Ronso introduction says two heritages but table lists four; block substitutions until reviewed.
Roegadyn Powerful Build and Seeq condition-dependent skills require manual adjudication.
Shindroid Magic Ineptitude prohibits MP except with Magitek Unit; Black Mage integration must block incompatible builds.
Shindroid summary says three heritages but actual table lists four; preserve four with partial Emotionless replacement review.
Tonkin mute vocal-component restriction must block automated Black Mage saving until feat support is present.
Seto Lion base speed already includes Fast and Quadruped; replacing Fast or adding Faster must not silently miscalculate movement.
Seto Lion summary index speed 40 ft conflicts with detailed page 50 ft; using 50 for staging pending review.
Shindroid summary index shows low-light vision but detailed traits only darkvision; low-light omitted until reviewed.
Varg Feral adds -2 INT without replacing standards; Light Build and Savant compete for score vector.
Viera Elemental Summoner and Mist Sight require mandatory single-option choices; current wizard handles them manually.
Varg and Viera heritage replacements remain blocked pending precise automation review.
Amalj'aa heritage alternate skills may not replace Stalker's class-skill grants; keep heritage selection manual.
Antica understand but do not speak their languages, and cannot cast spells without Silent Spell or Telepathic Spellcaster; Black Mage creation blocked until feat support.
Forgiven uses ambiguous skilled/Skill Bonus aliases and Scion of Mortality partial language/type replacement. Natural attack choice requires exactly one selection.
Gnath Carrion Sense is limited to dying creatures/corpses, not general scent. Day Raider removes Darkvision and Light Sensitivity together.
Ixal mandatory Bond to the Ice terrain and Elemental Summoner subtype have no character-builder choice binding; block builds until choices can be recorded.
Kindred starting Abyssal/Infernal choice and alternate Maw or Claw choice have no bound wizard selection UI; block such builds.
Goblin Hobgoblinoid size and score replacements need size engine verification; Pyromaniac CHA-dependent spell-like abilities and conditional Craft bonuses stay manual.
Goblin Moblin and Red Cap heritage Silver Tongued replacements unresolved; do not auto-apply.
Kindred source index lists -2 CHA but detailed racial page says -4 CHA; staged -4 from detailed page pending independent review.
Kobold source index lists 20-ft. base speed; detailed racial page says 30-ft. land and 20-ft. burrow; staged detailed values pending review.
Lamia Bond to the Land desert/water and Tempered water/wind choices cannot yet be recorded; block final saves.
Loporrit Handy Craft/Profession, Explorer/Hydaelyn Spark/Purpose-Driven skill selections require a race-choice UI; block saves while active.
Matanga Academic requires a selected Knowledge specialty and blocks save while active.
Lamia and Matanga heritages remain unresolved manual replacements. Source index differs from detailed Kojin, Loporrit and Matanga trait names.
Orc Skill Bonus has alternative Acrobatics vs Climb/Jump bonuses. No selection binding; prevent invalid save while active.
Quadav Bond to the Land requires choosing swamp or underground; block saving until selected terrain can be recorded.
Namazu Fast replaces both Skilled Traders and normal Base Speed; and Focused Study requires skill selection at 1, 8 and 16. Mark both replacements unresolved.
Qiqirn introduction states two heritages but its table contains Leaf-Eater, Meat-Eater, and Qitari (3); preserve all three with unresolved replacements.
Quadav Water Tribe modifies swim speed and grants amphibious breathing; movement calculation and substitution remain unresolved.
Sahagin Tempered requires a choice of water or ice resistance; do not save active trait without recorded choice.
Sylph Improved Flight changes land/fly speed but has non-speed source replacement; unresolved until movement engine supports this and should not save with alternate.
Trollkin Faster Healing replaces Thick Skin by source wording but also supersedes Fast Healing; compound substitution remains unresolved.
Trollkin weakness title Acid or Fire conflicts with effect text fire or earth. Do not infer second suppression element.
Sahagin, Sylph and Vanu Vanu heritages use alternative spell/skill mechanics and remain blocked pending review.
Velkk source summary calls detailed Water Resistant 'Elemental Resistance' and Survivalist 'Skill Bonus'; pending source nomenclature review.
Yagudo source table calls detailed Feathers of Gale 'Natural Armor' and Valiant Linguist 'Gifted Linguist'; table also mentions bite upgrade without detailed rule. Do not invent an upgrade.
Yagudo Zealot Devotee +1 per five Knowledge(religion) ranks and Valiant Linguist two languages per Linguistics rank need runtime progression and player language selection.
Monstrous Half-Gigas and Lizardman type in source summary says Humanoid but detailed entry says Monstrous Humanoid. Detailed entries used pending review.
Half-Gigas Fire/Ice/Thunder heritage trait substitutions remain unresolved and greyed out pending verification.
Syricta standard Elemental Resistance and Breath Weapon require two player choices the wizard cannot store; default save remains blocked rather than inventing choices.
Syricta Dragon Type, Evasive Maneuvers, Memories of the Forgotten, Neglected Heritage and Wing-Clipped have partial or source-conflicted type/speed/language changes and remain unavailable.
